description: This file manages session resolution, including session key generation, session store loading, and session freshness evaluation for a command agent in an OpenClaw project.

classes.name: SessionResolution
classes.description: Represents the result of resolving a session, including session ID, key, store, and state flags.

classes.name: SessionKeyResolution
classes.description: Contains details about a resolved session key, its store, and path.

classes.name: SessionIdMatchSet
classes.description: Holds sets of session ID matches across different stores for session lookup.

methods.name: buildExplicitSessionIdSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs an explicit session key string from session ID and optional agent ID.

methods.name: collectSessionIdMatchesForRequest
methods.description: Collects all session entries matching a given session ID across multiple stores.
